note: Boot sets hw-test.yml runs, by SHA-256. The runner host supplies the files under $DATAX_LAB_ARTIFACTS/<place>-<image>/ and scripts/hw/tron-run.sh refuses any file whose hash differs. Changing an image means a new entry here (and new evidence).

stock.description: ADRV9009-ZU11EG recovery PL (HDL main 085a6ed7) with the Kuiper 2023_R2 kernel and device tree; P2 streaming incl. TX and digital loopback

hopcap-sfp.description: hopcap SFP image with the Tick PPS selector (hopcap ac07d56, XSA 6292e762); P3a timed control, P2 RX

timed-dma.description: hopcap timed-dma profile (P3b): hopcap-sfp plus the Tick DMA gates, the RX capture tagger and the chip-B FHM route, with the stock TX DMA to the DAC restored (vrt49 VRT_DAC_TX_ENABLE=0), Tick clocked from core_clk_a (HMC7044 ch6, 122.88 MHz, locked to the sample clock; datax_sdk_sdr#40 option 1); P3b timed streams, P3a timed control, P2 incl. TX and loopback
timed-dma.tx_gate_edge_offset_note: Measured on tron 2026-11-24 (libdatax 291fa55, 3 bursts): mid-stream TX gate edges land 7 frames before the commanded time + the loopback offset - TX_START_MUTE_READS, i.e. the TX start_at mutes 10 reads, not 3, relative to the gate edges. Fixed latency of this image's gate path (P3b spec option 1 item 7); re-measure when the image changes.
